experienceDetails.Vertekx: Researched OCR engines, document parsers and model architectures under cost, security, accuracy and inference-time constraints. Compared approaches on sample data, explored and fine-tuned multiple models including LayoutLMv3 for 17 audit classes, and built the final FastAPI inference and validation layer. Led Phase 1 from research through working implementation, keeping the pipeline offline without external LLM/API calls.
experienceDetails.Exaverse: Builds serverless applications on Cloudflare Workers, Durable Objects, D1 and AI Gateway. Integrates generative AI, agentic workflows and RAG-powered features with deterministic validation and human-in-the-loop review.
experienceDetails.Kryzect: Delivers full-stack web, iOS/Android and AI product engineering. Architects MERN, Flask and Next.js systems through deployment on AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel and Render. Delivers Figma-to-React builds and manages project scoping through client handoff. The founding date conflicts with the website/profile and remains unresolved.
